note: Banking prints the customer's business facts directly in the Instructions (DECISIONS 88, option B; banking since DECISIONS 100). These are the only variables a banking Instructions set may use. Any other {{var.*}} is an error; so is an unresolved slot such as <business name>. This list replaces docs/shared/variables.json for banking. card_block_tool and balance_lookup_tool are intake flags, not variables: the skill writes the Instructions for the chosen state and names a tool only when it is on. 'status: unconfirmed' means the platform has not confirmed the variable exists.

variables.name: now_local
variables.description: Today's date and time for the call, with the dates of the coming days. Every date the agent says is read off this list.

variables.name: customer_name
variables.description: Outbound calls: the name of the customer being called. Used only to ask whether the person on the line is that customer; never said to anyone who is not confirmed as that customer, and never left on a voicemail. Whether the platform passes this is an open question; when empty the agent asks whether it is speaking with the customer.
